msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya. It breaks off near the end of the 9th story.

lg.l: || kathayaṃtīha tīrthānāṃ prabhāvānadbhutāṃs tathā

lomaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ | paryapṛchadyu
dhiṣṭaraḥ || 1 ||
|| yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman_ | bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |

tasya puṇyapha
laṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana || 2 ||
|| ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvo samayavaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya | prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 3 ||
idam eva purā devā|s tulayā samatolayan |

prā
ṇarakṣaṇam eveha | gauraveṇātiricyate || 4 ||
tatraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |

iṃdrasyāgne
ś ca saṃvādaṃ | śiver auśīnarasya ca ||
varttamāne mahāyajñe | jijñāsārthaṃ śivaṃ nṛpaṃ |

iṃdraśyenaḥ kapoto
gni|r bhūtvā tatropajāgmatuḥ || 6 ||
atha taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya | kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt |

śaraṇārthaṃ ma
hīpāla | nilise bhayavihvalaḥ || 7 ||
tataḥ śanair upāgamya | śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |

rājānaṃ sumahā
tmānaṃ | provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 8 ||

dharmātmānaṃ tvāhim iha prāhur ekaṃ rājan_ ma
hīkṣitāṃ |
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi | kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi || 9 ||

bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ dānena | satyenānṛtavā
dinaṃ |
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇa|m asādhuṃ sādhunāharat || 10 ||
nopakārāpareṣy eva|m upakāraparo janaḥ
apakārapare pi tvaṃ | upakaraparo yathā || 11 ||
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt |

doṣā
nveṣaṇadakṣe pi | guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 12 ||
tad evaṃ vihito bhakṣaḥ | pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |

mā
hiṃsye lobhato dharmaṃ | dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13 ||

|| saṃtrastarūpī trāṇārthī tvatto
bhīto vihaṃmamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ | prāṇagṛdhrurayaṃ ṣagaḥ || 14 ||

tad evam āgatasyāsya | ka
potasya mahātmanaḥ |
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryu|s tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ || 15 ||

lobhād veṣād bhayād vā
pi | yastyajecharaṇāgataṃ |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya | pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16 ||

śāstreṣu niḥkṛ
tir dṛṣṭā | mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahaṃtṛṇāṃ | na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit || 17 ||

yathā
tmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |

tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastā|s trātavyāḥ prāṇino bu
dhaiḥ || 18 ||
yanmamṛtyujarāduḥkhaiḥ|r nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |

jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte | mṛtyos trasyaṃti
te tathā || 19 ||
yannimittaṃ bhavechoka|s trāśo vā krodha eva ca |

āyāso vā nato mūlaṃ | ekāham api na
tyajet || 20 ||
maraikṣāṣyāmīti yaduḥkhaṃ | puruṣasyopajāyate

jñeyas tenānumānena || paro 'pi parirakṣayet
||
jathā hi te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ | tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ ||

saṃrakṣase jīvitam ā
tmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣi jīvitaṃ || 22 ||

tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppayiṣye ka
potakaṃ |
yad atra yuktam anyat te | karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada || 23 ||

prāyaḥ puruṣo loke | sarvabhū
tadayāparāḥ |
mahatām api yajñānāṃ | kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ || 24 ||

bhītābhayapradānasya | kṣa
ya eva na vidyate |
dattam iṣṭaṃ tathā taptaṃ | tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā || 25 ||

sarvāny abhayadanasya |
kalāṃ nārhata ṣoḍasīṃ ||
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni | saṃbhavaṃti nareśvara |

ā
hāreṇa vivarddhaṃte | tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 26 ||
śakyate na vināhārai|r rājan vardhayatuṃ ciraṃ |

śakya
te duṣkare py arthe | cirarātreṇa jīvituṃ || 27 ||
nārthair vināhāraṃ | jīvitaṃ kasyacid bhavet |

na tv ā
hāravihīnena | śakyaṃ vajījīvayatuṃ ciraṃ || 28 ||
bhakṣād vilopitasyātmā | mama prāṇā viśāṃpate |

vi
hāya yasyati paraṃ | paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ || 29 ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me | putradāraṃ mariṣyati |

rakṣamāṇaṃ
kapotatvaṃ | bahūn prāṇān haniṣyasi || 30 ||
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmaḥ | sa dharmo na mataḥ satāṃ ||

avirodhī
vayo dharma | sa dharma śadbhir ucyate || 31 ||
tasmād virodhe dharmasya | saṃciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ |

yato bhūya
s tato rājan_ kuru dharmaṃ vinirṇayaṃ || 32 ||

nāto bhūyataro dharmaḥ | kaści
d anyo sti ṣecaraḥ |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānā|m abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 33 ||

varam ekasya satvasya | prada
tvaṃ jīvitābhayaṃ |
na tu vipraśahasrasya | gosahasram alaṃkṛtaṃ || 34 ||

abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo | yo
dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya | na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 35 ||

hemadhenudharādīnāṃ |
dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuviḥ
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke | sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 36 ||

mahatām api yajñānāṃ | kā
lena kṣīyate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradānasya | kṣaya eva na vidyate |

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ | tīrthasevā śrutaṃ
tathā |
sarvvāṇy abhayadānasya | kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīṃ || 37 ||

catuḥsāgaraparyatāṃ | yo dadyāt pri
thivīm imāṃ |
abhayaṃ tasya bhūtebhya|s tayor abhayado 'dhikaḥ || 38 ||

api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarī
raṃ vāpi dustyajaṃ |
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ | tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ || 39 ||

yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃci
t tena janmani janmani |
bhaveyamam ārttānāṃ | prāṇināṃ ārtināśanaṃḥ || 40 ||

na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ
| na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ | kāmaye bhayanāśanaṃ || 41 ||

yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī
| mayaiṣā samudāhatā |
satyena tena bhagavān | prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ || 42 ||

āhārārthe samāraṃbha|s tava cā
yaṃ vihaṃgama |
tad yatheṣṭaṃ yathāhāra|m anyam eva dadāmy ahaṃ || 43 ||

sa eva vihito smā
kaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ | kāryam asty aparair mama || 44 ||

śyenāṣ kapotān_
khādaṃti || śrutir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan_ sāra saṃjñātvā | kadalīskaṃdham āruha || 45 ||
|| nāhaṃ uchāstramārgeṇa | kvacid varte vihaṃgama |

śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ | dharmasatvadayāpa
raḥ || 46 ||
sarvasatveṣu yad dāna|m ekasatve ca yā dayā |

sarvasatvapradānā tu | dayaikāsmād viśi
ṣyate || 47 ||
sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ | sarve yajñāś ca khecara |

sarvatīrthābhiṣekāś ca| cakrur yāt prāṇi
nāṃ dayā || 48 ||
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu | sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

dayādarśitapaṃthāno | brahma
loka vrajaṃti te || 49 ||
gachatas tiṣṭato vāpi | jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā |

yan na bhūtahitārthāya
| tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ || 50 ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni | sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |

ātmāvatparira
kṣaṃti | te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ || 51 ||
prāṇināṃ badhyamānānāṃ tu | yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate |

sa yāti
paramaṃ ghora|m iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 52 ||
rājyaṃ sivīnāṃ sakalaṃ | prayachāmi tava dvija |

yad vā kāmayase
hy anya|d varjayitvā kapojakam || 53 ||

yadi rājan_ kapote te | sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛ
śī ||
tattvaṃ kapotatulyāni | svamāṃsāni prayacha me || 54 ||

|| anugraham imaṃ manye
| yan māṃ śyeno bhiyācase |
etat te haṃ prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi || 55 ||

yat pṛyaṃ tat suhajjaṃ
tu|ś cirād vadati mānavaḥ |
mama tu priyam evaita|t kasmād ibhihitaṃ cirāt || 56 ||

adhruveṇa prāśa
rīreṇa | pratikṣaṇavināśinā |
dhruvaṃ yo nārjeyed dharma | sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ || 57 ||

yadi prā¦
ṇyupakārāya | deho yaṃ naupayujyate ||
tat tat kim upakāro tra | pratyahaṃ kṛyate vṛthā || 58 ||
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce | tāvan māṃsaṃ nareśvara |

tasmāt kapotena samaṃ | prayacha tulayā dhṛ
taṃ || 59 ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi | yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase |

yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me¦
syāt | dattena ca vihaṃgama || 60 ||
evam uktā svamāṃsāni | samutkṛṃtya sa pārthivaḥ |

prahṛ
ṣṭas tolayāmāsa | kapotena saha prabhuḥ || 61 ||
|| tyaktātmasuṣabhogechāṃ | sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |

bha
vaṃti paraduḥkhena | sādhavo nityaduḥṣitāḥ || 62 ||
dhṛyamāṇas tu tulyā | kapoto vyatiricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ || 63 ||

na vidyate yathā māṃsaṃ | kapotena samaṃ kva
cit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sau || aruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ || 64 ||

paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ | sarvabhūtahi
te ratāḥ |
nāpekṣaṃte mahānmānaḥ | svasukhāni mahāṃty api || 65 ||

atha tasmin samārūḍhe | tulā
m auśīnare nṛpe ||
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ | puṣpavṛṣṭi papāta ha || 66 ||

tatas tasya tadā matvā | dharmo
rājño dhṛtiṃ parāṃ |
śākraḥ svarūpam āsthāya | vākyam etad abhāṣata || 67 ||

|| iṃdro
haṃm asmi bhadraṃ te | kapoto havyarāḍayaṃ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājan_ | imaṃ yajñam upāgatau || 68 ||

naitat pū
rve nṛpāś cakru|r na kariṣyaṃti cāpare |
mahākāruṇikeneha | yat kṛtaṃ duḥṣkaraṃ tvayā || 69 ||

parārthe tyaja
taḥ prāṇān_ | yā prītir abhavat tava |
prāṇaśaṃsayalubdheṣu | nanv āprāṇeṣu dehināṃ || 70 ||

parārthaikāṃtaka
lyāṇī | svaśreyo tyaṃtaniṣṭurā |
tvayy eva kevalo rājan | karuṇā vyatiricyate || 71 ||

svakarmapāśaiḥ
sudṛḍhai|r baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat |
tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ | baddhaḥ karuṇāyā nṛpa || 72 ||

tathā sarvātma
nā vāpi | doṣeṣu prahataṃ tvayā |
tathaivam ātmanasthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate || 73 ||

akṛtverṣyāṃ vi
śiṣṭeṣu na hīnānavamanya ca |
akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ spardhāṃ | tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ || 74 ||

paropakāra
janmāno vi|dhātrā vihitās trayaḥ |
sajalā jaladās tvaṃ ca | saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ || 75 ||

ātmā
prāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān | yo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa yāti paraṃ dhāma | yato nāvarttate punaḥ || 76 ||

prā
ṇair api tvayā rājan | rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ khagaḥ |

svamāṃsāny ca dattāni | dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā
|| 77 ||
naraḥ paropakārāṇā|m āpat sulabhate phalaṃ |
aṃgeṣv eva jarāya tu | yat tvayopakṛtaṃ śive || 78 ||
paśavo ya hi jīvaṃti | kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ |

sa puna jīvitaḥ ślāghyo | yaḥ parārthe hi jīvati || 7
9 ||
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ | parānugrahatatparāḥ |
na hi svadehaśītāya | yā yaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ || 80 ||
paropakāravyāpāra|paro yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā |
sa padaṃ tad avāpnoti | parād api hi yat paraṃ || 81 ||

paropa
kāraikadhiyaḥ | svasuṣāya gataspṛhāḥ ||
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte | sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi || 82 ||

ya
t te māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ | samutkṛtāni pārthiva |
eṣā te śāsvatī kīrtti|r lokān anugamiṣyati || 83
divyarūpadharaś caiva | pālayitvā ciran mahīṃ |

sarvān_ lokān atikramya | brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati || 8
4 ||
|| evam uktvā nam iṃdrāgnī yagmatus tridaśālayaṃ |

rājā ca sya kratum iṣṭvā ya
mamude devavac ciraṃ || 85 ||
|| ya idaṃ śṛṇā nityaṃ | śiveś carivam uttamaṃ |

sa vihāyeha pāpāni | prayāti
tridivaṃ paraṃ || 86 ||
viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ | yaśaḥ sarvajanasya durlabhaṃ |

śarīradānat parajī
varakṣaṇaṃ || vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || 87 ||

body.p:
|| śrī || || itihāsasamuccaye śyenakapotīyo
nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || || 4 ||
